## Objective

Install the exact local runtime, initialize root-local state under the root digest-bound adoption contract, and validate the approved root source set.

## Scope

- Wheel build and root environment install, digest-bound root adoption, source discovery, synchronization, exact recall, canonical reread, optional local-provider validation

## Entry conditions

- Root controls and source registry pass without state creation.
- Separate authority exists for environment installation and root Memory System initialization.

## Exit criteria

- TASK-022 through TASK-024 have current installation, initialization, isolation, source, recall, and receipt evidence.

## Risks

- This phase changes the root environment and creates derived state.
- Local model or provider capability may be unavailable and must not trigger cloud fallback.

## TASK-022 - Build, record, and install the exact root runtime

Build the immutable Memory Service wheel from the inspected checkout, record version and SHA-256, install that exact artifact into the root .venv, and verify import provenance through the hardened Sys4AI package boundary.

### Risks

- Installation changes the root environment and requires separate execution authority for the exact plan.
- Import verification must not import Cognee outside the hardened adapter.

### Acceptance criteria

- The build receipt binds source revision, package version, wheel filename, and SHA-256.
- The root environment reports a non-editable install from the exact wheel and no sibling checkout path.
- No package publication, dependency unlock, or direct Cognee import occurs.
- Source provenance binds the Memory Service source manifest and immutable package hash, plus its own HEAD if an independent repository exists. Record unavailable Git metadata as null; never label Sys4AI HEAD as a product commit.

### Planned verification

- Run the locked build and verify the wheel hash.
- Inspect installed distribution metadata and module path without importing Cognee directly.
- Run a safe provider-boundary smoke with project-local environment paths.

## TASK-023 - Initialize the sys4ai-depot Memory System

### Risks

- This task creates local derived state and may initialize the provider or local models only under separate execution authority.
- A failure after some directories exist must return truthful recovery state and must not touch user-wide Cognee files.

### Acceptance criteria

- The separately authorized root adoption validates its current configuration and accepted digest, initializes only approved private root-local state, and writes the REQ-013 digest-bound receipt.
- Root adoption shares one validation/initialization implementation with direct new/manual bootstrap while retaining its entry-specific review; direct new-project outputs still contain no preview object or preview digest.
- The receipt accurately distinguishes directory/configuration initialization, exact-service readiness and provider/model activation; filesystem evidence shows no new user-wide or child-project runtime state.

### Planned verification

- Capture project and user-wide provider path baselines without reading secret contents.
- Exercise the root digest-bound entry with separately authorized scope, then compare its shared-core contract to the direct new/manual routes.
- Validate receipt, file modes, resolved paths, exact-service readiness and truthful provider activation state.

- Live root sources may contain sensitive or unrelated dirty content that must remain excluded by registry and secret scan.
- Local model or provider availability may be a truthful deferred capability rather than permission to fetch or use cloud fallback.

### Acceptance criteria

- Discovery reports the complete registered and excluded set before ingestion.
- Exact retrieval and canonical reread work for representative root identifiers, and no child-project content appears.
- Any unexercised semantic or model-backed check is reported explicitly without weakening exact-mode acceptance or using remote fallback.

### Planned verification

- Run source discovery and review counts and locators.
- Synchronize only the approved source IDs and inspect operation receipt.
- Run exact, authority, child-exclusion, and representative hybrid queries; record any model gate separately.
